title: My friends and I have been playing my Auto-Battler MMORPG
author: Fansyy
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Some time ago I started developing a auto battler game ([free on the web](https://pixel.share.zrok.io), no reg required) where you build your character with different passives and fight enemies.  
One thing let to another and this project grew a lot, it’s a fun side project that I’m really loving.  
You can create different builds and choose the typical three clases Warrior Mage and Hunter,

I’m using AI art but hopefully it’s all placeholders for now. There is pvp,pve and coop pve and many many features. I tried to make it simple and also complex for people that wonna dive deep :D

It’s been a really cool experience not having to worry about code and define tests and how you want them to perform.( Currently every new passive created 20k new test cases so I might need to revisit that lol.)  
Not sure how you guys do it, but my process of developing a new feature mainly focuses on explaining what I want build, how I want it and then lay out all the corner cases I can think of. Then I ask the model to help me think of what I haven’t thought of and that helps me develop the feature even better because you can prepare the tests for these corner cases. You really need to be clear what you need and DONT need, because sometimes it goes crazy with the imagination. I also try to make the features small enough so I can thoroughly test everything before marking it as done.  
My favourite thing is when I start writing out a feature a random idea pops in my head and I tell the AI to write it down for future thinking, and now that md is with over 1000 lines.

The cool part (in my opinion) is that you have a fixed amount of turns every 30m and the core mechanic is that the best 10% in each village (there are 7) advance to the next one, and the bottom 10% get back to the previous one. And each village unlocks a new feature. All the features without going indepth:  
\- over 130 passives(3 levels each)  
\- PVE PVP COOP PVE  
\- Unique Villages  
\- Crafting  
\- in the villages you unlock Market, Bank, Workshop, Enchanter, Refinery, Training yard( you can test ur bold A vs your build B), Fight vs multiple enemies at once, and much more

Id love to hear your feedback on the game and how you approach your games

I’m posting regular updates on my [tiktok](https://www.tiktok.com/@pixelempiresofficial?_r=1&_t=ZN-9BKF7tJovby) channel.
